mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notifications ( store_id, title, content, type, target_role, created_by ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{targetRole}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO system_notification_recipients ( notification_id, account_id, table_session_id, status, read_at ) SELECT #{notificationId}, accounts.id, NULL, 'UNREAD', NULL FROM accounts WHERE accounts.store_id = #{storeId} AND accounts.role = 'OPERATOR' AND accounts.status = 'ACTIVE'

INSERT INTO system_notification_recipients ( notification_id, account_id, table_session_id, status, read_at ) SELECT #{notificationId}, NULL, table_sessions.id, 'UNREAD', NULL FROM table_sessions INNER JOIN dining_tables ON dining_tables.id = table_sessions.table_id WHERE dining_tables.store_id = #{storeId} AND table_sessions.status IN ('OPEN', 'PAYMENT_PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT system_notifications.id AS id, system_notifications.title AS title, system_notifications.content AS content, system_notifications.type AS type, system_notifications.target_role AS targetRole, system_notifications.created_at AS createdAt, system_notifications.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM system_notifications WHERE system_notifications.store_id = #{storeId} ORDER BY system_notifications.created_at DESC, system_notifications.id DESC

SELECT system_notifications.id AS id, system_notifications.title AS title, system_notifications.content AS content, system_notifications.type AS type, system_notifications.target_role AS targetRole, system_notification_recipients.status AS status, system_notification_recipients.read_at AS readAt, system_notifications.created_at AS createdAt FROM system_notification_recipients INNER JOIN system_notifications ON system_notifications.id = system_notification_recipients.notification_id WHERE system_notification_recipients.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY system_notifications.created_at DESC, system_notifications.id DESC

SELECT system_notifications.id AS id, system_notifications.title AS title, system_notifications.content AS content, system_notifications.type AS type, system_notifications.target_role AS targetRole, system_notification_recipients.status AS status, system_notification_recipients.read_at AS readAt, system_notifications.created_at AS createdAt FROM system_notification_recipients INNER JOIN system_notifications ON system_notifications.id = system_notification_recipients.notification_id WHERE system_notification_recipients.table_session_id = #{tableSessionId} ORDER BY system_notifications.created_at DESC, system_notifications.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_notification_recipients WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'UNREAD'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_notification_recipients WHERE table_session_id = #{tableSessionId} AND status = 'UNREAD'
